provenance.classification: USER-AUTHORIZED RESEARCH ASSUMPTIONS; not an identified, measured or certified C208B model. Not the modern EX/PT6A-140.
provenance.source: Lampton and Valasek, JAST clean Table 1 and Table 2; https://vscl.tamu.edu/wp-content/uploads/sites/134/2017/07/JAST_icing.pdf
provenance.mass: 8402 lb research operating weight converted using 0.45359237 kg/lb, rounded to 3811.084 kg; fixed CG/inertia, not MTOW.
provenance.geometry: 25.96 m2 and 15.85 m are declared representative research geometry, not confirmed for Table 2 configuration; mean chord S/b approximation.
provenance.table1_reused: CL0=.26 CLq=10.27 CLde=.54 Cm0=.10 Cmalpha=-.78 Cmq=-28.95 Cmde=-1.61 CYbeta=-1.04 CYdr=.23 Clbeta=-.10 Clp=-.59 Clda=.15 Cldr=.02 Cnbeta=.10 Cnr=-.20 Cnda=-.01. Research/calculated coefficients, not full-envelope flight-test identification.
provenance.coefficient_conversion: reference_pitch_rad=Cm0/(-Cmalpha); lift_ref=CL0+assumed_CLalpha*reference_pitch_rad. Thus core clean Cm=.10-.78*alpha-1.61*de and CL=.26+4.5*alpha+.54*de. Table combined -CLalpha-CD1=-4.53 is NOT CLalpha.
provenance.assumed_aero: CLalpha=4.5, drag polar, CYp/CYr/CYda=0, Clr=.15 Cnp=-.03 Cndr=.12, nonlinear separation, all flap increments and actuator responses are development assumptions; no published response validation. Spoiler/aileron coupling and asymmetric surface limits omitted.
provenance.inertia: Ix=12000 Iy=22000 Iz=30000 Ixz=500 kg m2; hypothetical mass distribution, no same-configuration evidence.
provenance.propulsion: 503350 W nominal shaft power is an explicit 675 shp class assumption, not verified research configuration. Efficiency .8, static thrust m*2.5 N, ISA density power lapse and 1.5 s spool are assumed. Thrust=min(static,eta*P*rho/rho0/V). No reaction torque, slipstream, RPM/governor, reverse or feathering.
provenance.ground: All FRD contact points, body strike geometry, fixed tricycle gear, friction and impact threshold 4m/s are development assumptions; not measured landing gear or certified landing loads.
provenance.control: All envelope, flap schedule, speed limits, path dimensions, time scale and controller gains are research operating choices; 0..110m/s numerical support is not validated full-envelope aerodynamics.

support_message: C208B research model: estimated inertia, propulsion, low-speed aerodynamics, gear and controller. REAL AIRCRAFT PERFORMANCE UNVALIDATED.
